metadata.title: That 1 kill where I barely touched the mouse and Valorant said ‘Here, have it’ LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, I wasn’t even ready for that!
Enemy just handed me a freebie like it’s a charity.
Click if your best plays come with zero effort and max confusion.
Valorant logic is straight trolling again.

Tap if your aim’s on vacation but kills keep rolling in!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
